newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on commercials, exporters.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on commercials, exporters.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended up on commercial and export demand, traders said.

"We had good exporter buying, Cargill bought the Nov, UGG bought March, locals turned aggressive sellers at the close when Chicago broke," a trader said. Nov-Jan spread at $3.30, Nov-May $4.50, July-Nov $41. Volume was 3,570 with 430 hedges.
Japan bought 10,000 tonnes of canola, sources said.
November canola rose $1.50 to $406.50, January up $2 to $410.50. November flax rose $0.20 to $368.70. Volume was 160.
November barley up $0.90 to $145.50 on commercials Midland Walwyn sold February up $0.40 to $148. Nov-Feb spread at $3.
October feed wheat rose $1.20 to $176.70 on commission short covering met by commercial sales, December rose $1.70 to $170. Dec-Mar rose $1. Volume was 1,225.
UGG sold 25 December feed peas unchanged at US$199. Cargill bought 10 December oats up US$2 at US$132 from Richardson's.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats). -- Gilbert Le Gras 204 947 3548
